signs.text: THE GREAT STALACTITE. Hanging seven metres from the roof, it is one of the longest free-hanging stalactites in Europe. Limestone dripped it into shape, very slowly, over a very long time.

text: The roof drips, steadily and without hurry. Each drop leaves a film of limestone behind, which is how the whole place was made.
You look up at seven metres of stone, hanging from the roof on nothing at all. Stalactites grow very slowly, so this one has had a lot of time to think about it.
Somewhere above, in a field, a cow has no idea.
